basic_info.description: Very ornate, completely detached Rousseau-style home with outstanding curb appeal and architectural details throughout. Fabulous sunken living room with high ceilings and large arched floor to ceiling windows with beautiful curved fireplace and mantle. Step up into the dramatic dining room through the arched entryway. Kitchen off dining room opens into formal breakfast nook. Both large bedrooms overlook the spacious back yard, Art Deco full bath completes this level. Lots of light, crown moldings and parquet hardwood floors throughout. Extra large room and bath on garden level. Parking for one car, lots of storage and laundry facilities. Large south-facing backyard. Close to schools, shops and transportation. Short drive to Ocean Beach.
